text: Zhejiang Leapmotor Technology Co., Ltd. (HKEX 09863) discloses in its 2025 annual report that founder Zhu Jiangming, Fu Liquan and their spouses act in concert as its "Single Largest Group of Shareholders" (each deemed interested in 337,618,377 shares, 23.75% of total share capital); Stellantis N.V. holds 284,260,030 shares (19.99%); and Hangzhou state-enterprise-backed pre-IPO fund Guoshun Lingpao holds 12,107,202 shares (0.85%).
short: Leapmotor (HKEX 09863): founder Zhu Jiangming's concert group is the single largest shareholder group (23.75%); Stellantis 19.99%.

source.name: Zhejiang Leapmotor Technology Co., Ltd. — Annual Report 2025 (HKEX filing, English), Directors' Report: substantial shareholders
source.quote: Accordingly, Mr. Zhu, Mr. Fu, Ms. Liu and Ms. Chen are members of the Single Largest Group of Shareholders with respect to their shareholding in the Company.
source.note: Substantial-shareholders tables as at 31 December 2025: Ms. Liu (Zhu Jiangming's spouse, acting in concert) is deemed interested in 209,100,538 H Shares (14.71%) plus 128,517,839 Domestic Shares (9.04%) — 23.75% of total share capital in all; note 3 spells out the acting-in-concert agreement between Zhu Jiangming and Fu Liquan (renewed 5 March 2025, runs to 28 September 2028). Stellantis is listed as beneficial owner of 239,260,030 H Shares (16.83%) and 45,000,000 Domestic Shares (3.16%) — 19.99% in all. Guoshun Lingpao, a pre-IPO fund whose limited partners are Hangzhou state-owned enterprises, holds 12,107,202 Domestic Shares (0.85%).
